ns2:section.sectionText: deaf*—a term to describe a multiplicity of non-normative experiences, vantages, and epistemologies in/around aurality, orality, communication, listening, and beyond— is emergent, speculative, re: generative, and horizontal (of/towards the sensorium’s horizon). This course will explore, chart, apply, and expand upon deaf* creative/critical methodologies through a combination of theoretical, practical, and historical modes. deaf* will also critically engage issues of access, embodiment, and representation through an applied cripistemological framework and a consideration of the social and political histories of hard of hearing and d/Deaf individuals.
